info.name: Clerk Backend Account Portal Payment Attempts API

params.name: limit
params.description:
Applies a limit to the number of results returned.
Can be used for paginating the results together with `offset`.

params.name: offset
params.description:
Skip the first `offset` results when paginating.
Needs to be an integer greater or equal to zero.
To be used in conjunction with `limit`.

params.name: paginated
params.description:
Whether to paginate the results.
If true, the results will be paginated.
If false, the results will not be paginated.

items.docs: Returns a list of payment attempts for the current user.

params.name: paymentAttemptID
params.description: The ID of the payment attempt to retrieve

items.docs: Returns details of a specific payment attempt for the current user.
